title: Why Your Windshield Wipers Have This Hidden Position
hook: Most drivers park their wipers completely wrong.

script.narration: Most drivers park their wipers completely wrong in winter.
script.visual_search: car windshield wipers in snow close up

script.narration: Leaving them down lets freezing snow lock the rubber directly against the glass. Using the service mode flips them upward so they never freeze stuck to your windshield.

description:
Learn the correct way to position your windshield wipers during freezing weather to prevent frozen rubber and damaged motors. This quick driving tip protects your vehicle and improves morning visibility instantly.
